## Task Description
Implement [specific functionality/algorithm/module].

## Module/Algorithm
- **Module**: src/optimization/ or src/covariance/ etc.
- **Class/Function**: ClassName or function_name
- **Type**: Algorithm / Module Framework / Dashboard / Testing

## Specifications
What needs to be implemented?

### Core Requirements
- [ ] Requirement 1
- [ ] Requirement 2
- [ ] Requirement 3

### Technical Specifications
- Input types and shapes
- Output format
- Algorithm details
- Dependencies

### Reference Materials
- [Research Paper Name](link)
- [Documentation](link)
- [Similar Implementation](link)

## Implementation Checklist

### Code Implementation
- [ ] Main class/function implemented
- [ ] All methods implemented with docstrings
- [ ] Type hints added for all parameters/returns
- [ ] Error handling implemented
- [ ] Logging added for key operations
- [ ] Integration with factory patterns if applicable

### Testing
- [ ] Unit tests written (minimum 80% coverage)
- [ ] Edge cases tested
- [ ] Large dataset testing (if performance-critical)
- [ ] All tests passing locally

### Code Quality
- [ ] Code formatted with black
- [ ] Linting passed (flake8)
- [ ] Type checking passed (mypy)
- [ ] No TODOs left unless intentional

### Documentation
- [ ] Comprehensive docstrings added
- [ ] Examples in docstrings
- [ ] README.md updated if needed
- [ ] docs/methodology/METHODOLOGY.md updated
- [ ] docs/ROADMAP.md updated

### Integration
- [ ] Integrates with existing patterns
- [ ] Configuration management updated
- [ ] Logging setup complete
- [ ] No breaking changes

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All unit tests pass
- [ ] Code coverage >= 80%
- [ ] Code review approved
- [ ] Documentation complete
- [ ] Merges without conflicts

## Estimated Effort
- [ ] Small (1-2 hours)
- [ ] Medium (2-4 hours)
- [ ] Large (4-8 hours)
- [ ] Very Large (8+ hours)

## Related Resources
- Research papers or references
- Similar implementations to learn from
- Architecture decisions or patterns to follow

## Implementation Notes
Add notes as you work:
- Challenges encountered
- Solutions applied
- Design decisions made
- Performance characteristics

## Related Issues
- Closes/relates to #(issue number)
- Depends on #(issue number)
